verdict.rationale: Connect supports some automatic background behaviour: payouts can run on a configurable schedule (docs-13), funds split to sellers automatically (docs-2), and no-code pricing strategies apply to processing (docs-8). Webhooks (docs-15) and the official MCP server (probe-4) let users build their own event-driven or agent-driven automations, but that takes custom code or extra tooling rather than a native automation builder. missing for 10: a general-purpose user-configurable automation/workflow feature, evidence of autonomous agent-driven background runs, independent corroboration of automation use.
